_doc: Achievements (design/lives/lives-and-carryover-spec.md §7; build items N-1.2 frame, N-7.7 the list). Deeds the soul remembers: never raw power. Each has a kind (region, school, life, craft, story, challenge), a name, a hint (shown for hidden ones as '?'), when (a story condition, checked through the day and as a life ends: ended(cause) and omens() are true only then and this life), and grants: title (worn on the Deeds tab; people's reactions come later). A road's opens_by may name an achievement id. hidden: shows as '?' with its hint until earned. sealed: a story achievement, shown only as 'A deed not yet done' (SEALED, written by the story threads).
